text:
Elaine_SE: Quick heads-up — XenithHealth trial timeline. Need infra signoff, API contract final, and code reviews done before dry-run next Tue. Sharing ask list below; tag owners.

Michael_R: Thanks, Elaine. Can you confirm dry-run window? We need to schedule SE + customer sandbox at least 48h earlier.

Elaine_SE: Dry-run = Tue Oct 10 09:00–11:00 PT. Customer prefers morning. Goal: end-to-end inference + latency smoke + billing sanity.

Sam_Infra: I can do infra signoff by Mon EOD if network certs are in. Who owns the SAN cert? @nina_product?

Nina_Product: Not me. Security requested certs from customer. Priya, do you have contact for cert upload?

Priya_SE: I have them on the thread with Xenith. I'll drop the S3 upload link and a note. Expect upload today.

Raj_Runtime: Heads up — we need to pin the model to `xenith-llama-1.2.0` and enable 8-bit activations. Otherwise p95 jumps. PR open: #6834.

Elaine_SE: Noted. Raj, can you confirm rollback steps if quantization regresses quality? We need a simple switch during dry-run.

Raj_Runtime: Yes — toggle `MODEL_VARIANT=xenith-llama-1.2.0` -> `xenith-llama-1.2.0-full` in deploy config. I'll add a small runbook.

Jordan_QA: Test matrix: 1) latency smoke (50 runs) 2) correctness check on 12 seed prompts 3) billing event verification. I can run cases on Wed if env is ready.

Michael_R: CRs: two outstanding. PR #6829 (API contract changes) needs a review from Sam, and PR #6834 (quant flags) needs Raj + Nina product sanity. Pinged both.

Sam_Infra: Reviewing #6829 now. Quick note — the new /batch_predict response includes `request_id` field; that's fine.

Nina_Product: I'll sanity-check output for the 12 prompts. If any drift >5% we'll flag. Jordan, can you include the prompt set in repo under `xenith/traces/`?

Jordan_QA: Yep — pushed `xenith/prompt_set_v1.json`. Link: https://git.redwood/xenith/prompt_set_v1.json

Priya_SE: Upload link posted to Xenith S3. @sam_infra let me know when you can test certificate retrieval.

Sam_Infra: Got link. I'll pull cert and validate chain by today.

Elaine_SE: Success criteria recap — 1) p95 infer < 220ms on dedicated pool, 2) correctness pass >=95% on prompt set, 3) billing events show cost per token within expected band, 4) rollbacks documented. 

Priya_SE: Customer will sign-off only if point 2 and 4 ok. I'll prep the sign-off doc.

Raj_Runtime: Quick CR ping — if anyone can LGTM #6834 today that helps unblock config freeze.

Michael_R: I can take #6834 midday.

Sam_Infra: LGTM for #6829, left one nit about logging key.

Jordan_QA: Starting smoke runs once certs validated. ETA Wed 10:00 PT.

ci-bot: deploy started: infra/xenith-sandbox -> staging (build 2026.10.06-1012)

Elaine_SE: Perfect — thanks team. If anything slips, call an async rollback meeting. :thumbsup:

Priya_SE: I'll post final timeline + sign-off doc link when ready.

Michael_R: small ask — can we add a temporary route in Redwood Console for Xenith telemetry? Two-hour window during dry-run.

Sam_Infra: Can do. I'll add route and TTL = 3h. Will ping when live.

Raj_Runtime: Added runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/raj/runtime-rollbacks. Includes the env toggle and sanity checks.

Elaine_SE: Great. Last ask: please add LGTM in the PRs and drop any blockers here. We'll retouch tomorrow at EOD if open items remain.
